lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance spots are organized in a semi-regular grid consisting of approximately four horizontal rows on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form a matrix, where circular high-luminance blobs act as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper and mid-flank, each characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the superior edge to deep shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance spots, primarily clustered near the anterior base and leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, more numerous high-luminance spots compared to the flank; a remora is clearly visible attached to the ventral surface near the pectoral fin base.
